commit.subject: LU-14291 llog: test if dt_device not an ERR_PTR
commit.message:
LU-14291 llog: test if dt_device not an ERR_PTR

The macro lu2dt_dev() uses container_of_safe() which can return
an ERR_PTR. This never handled in the llog code so test if the
dt_device have been freed or is in an error state.
